violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees - 15 clock hours Annual Training for Caregivers & Site Directors (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(5)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees - 15 clock hours Annual Training for Caregivers & Site Directors
violation_type.typical_finding: A site director did not have annual training hours: 3/6/2023 to 3/6/2024.

finding_variants.text: A site director did not have annual training hours: 3/6/2023 to 3/6/2024.
One caregivers has 3 of the required 15 hours of training. The caregiver also does not have any of the required topics.
Based on the documentation reviewed during the inspection multiple caregivers have not completed their annual training.
There were no training certificates for one of the caregivers.
No trainings were available during today's follow-up.  The program director was out and not available today.
One caregiver had 12.5 hours of the required 15 hours of annual training available for review at time of inspection.
